In detail

Europe's largest medieval old town, and the part of Genoa the city polices hardest. From 15 September 2026 the local police cover it 24 hours a day under the Comune's 2026 urban safety plan, with the named perimeter being the Darsena, the stretch between Prè and the old ghetto, and the axis from Maddalena and San Luca through vico delle Mele to piazza Banchi — against dealing, loitering and degradation. That is the same warren that holds via Garibaldi and the Rolli palaces, San Lorenzo and the Porto Antico, which are busy and fine. The caruggi do not separate into good and bad streets on a map; they change character in fifty metres and again after dark. Walk the lit axes at night and use a taxi for the rest.
